name: reset-sizes-extension
description: Reset all size-related changes (UI zoom, editor font zoom, terminal font zoom, and optionally size-related settings) back to defaults.

resetSizes.confirmBeforeDestructiveReset.description: Show a modal confirmation before clearing persisted settings. The dialog names the specific keys and scopes that will be cleaned. Recommended to keep enabled.

resetSizes.showSummaryNotification.description: Show a summary notification after each reset, naming what was changed.
resetSizes.showSummaryNotification.markdownDescription:
Show a summary notification after each reset, naming what was changed.

The detailed run-by-run record is available in the activity log: [Open Reset Sizes activity log](command:resetSizes.openActivityLog).

Want to see what a reset would change before you run it? Open the read-only matrix: [Open Reset Sizes preview](command:resetSizes.openPreview).

resetSizes.reloadSilently.description: When a reset changes settings that require a window reload, reload immediately without prompting. Set to true by choosing "Reload and don't ask again" on the post-reset prompt; toggle off to bring the prompt back.

resetSizes.showInActivityBar.description: Show a Reset Sizes icon in the Activity Bar. The icon opens the read-only Preview view. The Preview view is always reachable from the Command Palette regardless of this setting.

scripts.install-local: npm run compile && npm run package && code --install-extension extension.vsix --force
